name: How often should I get a roof wear-and-tear assessment?

mainEntity.name: How often should I get a roof wear-and-tear assessment?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is generally recommended to get a professional roof assessment every 1-3 years, especially if your roof is older than 10 years or after severe weather events. Regular assessments help in early detection of issues, which can prevent minor problems from escalating into costly repairs. Considering the varied weather patterns in the DFW area, an annual check-up can provide peace of mind and extend your roof's lifespan.
acceptedAnswer.description: Assess your roof every 1-3 years, particularly if it's over 10 years old or after severe weather, to catch issues early and extend its lifespan.
